title: Written From In Here
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: I wrote 'hi' on the bus window. Something wrote back.
first_visual: A fogged bus window in sodium light; a finger-drawn word, new letters forming beside it.

beats.visual: Fogged window; Ivy's finger draws in the fog; new letters form beside it.
beats.vo: I wrote 'hi' on the bus window. Something wrote back.
It knew my name. From outside, I thought.

beats.visual: Ivy leans in, frowning at the letters.
beats.vo: Then I realised: I could read it.

beats.visual: Close on the letters: they read correctly from her side of the glass.
The empty seat beside her: a fresh handprint in the fog at that window.
beats.vo: It was written from in here.

beats.visual: New words: YOU'RE ON MY LAP (overlay).
Key moment: Ivy freezes; her breath fogs; a second plume fogs the glass just above her head.

ending: Last line in the fog: 'YOU'RE ON MY LAP.' A second breath plume fogs the glass just above her head.
loop_note: No. It ends on the breath image.

originality_review: Original. The 'mirror-writing logic' reveal is our own. Fog writing is a generic image, but the deduction twist is not borrowed from any known creator. Different from MW011 (memory passengers).
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: On the last bus Ivy writes 'HI' in the fog. Replies appear at speed. She realises she can read them normally, so they were written from inside the bus, from right beside her.

hooks.line: I wrote 'hi' on the bus window. Something wrote back.
hooks.first_visual: A fogged bus window in sodium light; a finger-drawn word, new letters forming beside it.

hooks.line: If it were outside, the words would be backwards.
hooks.first_visual: Close on letters in fog from the passenger's side.

hooks.line: Fifty miles an hour, and something's writing on my window.
hooks.first_visual: Streetlights streaking past a fogged window.

hooks.line: The last thing it wrote: where it was sitting.
hooks.first_visual: A second breath plume fogging the glass above a woman's head.

setting: Night bus, back seat, bypass at speed, sodium light.
conflict: Ivy assumes something is outside the bus and works out the truth.
escalation: A reply, then her name, then the realisation about the letters' direction.
reveal: A fresh handprint in the fog by the empty seat beside her.
